rows.text: looks for a node whose dword `+0x14` equals `ecx` on the chain that starts at qword `0215FD58` and links through qword `+8`, then, if none is found, on the chain that starts at qword `0215FD78`; when a node is found it decrements its word `+0x1C` and, when the result is not above 0 (signed) and byte `+0x19` AND 3 is non-zero, stores 0 to that word; when no node is found it returns without writing
